reconcile.note: Gill harmonizes the accounts by noting the tree withered instantly but the disciples only noticed its dried state the next morning as they passed by.

sides.snippet: Immediately the fig tree withered away.
sides.verseText: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, \"Let there be no fruit from you forever!\" Immediately the fig tree withered away.

sides.snippet: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
sides.verseText: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
